newsitem.title: USA: Flowers makes stock split, raises dividend. [CORRECTED 17:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Flowers makes stock split, raises dividend. [CORRECTED 17:50 GMT]

text.p: Flowers Industries Inc said Friday its board of directors had declared a three-for-two stock split (Corrects from three-to-one stock split) by means of a 50-percent stock dividend.
It said the board also increased the quarterly dividend to $0.1075 payable on the split shares.
Flowers had paid $0.155 per share quarterly on a presplit basis.
The company said the dividend and the split were payable on May 2 to shareholders of record on April 18.
The dividend increase was the company's seventy-first consecutive quarterly rise.
On March 31, Flowers reported 58.2 million in average shares diluted during its 1996 third quarter. Average primary shares totalled 58.2 million.
On Thursday, its stock closed at 23-1/8 on the New York Stock Exchange.
